title: Jesus' Plan To Stop Future Anxiety (Matthew 6)
hook: Worried about tomorrow? Jesus gave a plan for today.
script: Worried about tomorrow? Jesus gave a plan for today. In Matthew 6, He says, look up. Birds do not budget and lilies do not hustle, yet the Father feeds and clothes them. Your worth is higher. Next, refocus your values: seek first His Kingdom. Ask, what shows God's love in my next hour? Finally, stay in today. Try this: write your worries, schedule a 10-minute worry time tonight, then return to now. It is called worry postponement, and Jesus said each day has enough trouble of its own. Pray with me: Father, give me today's bread, today's step, and today's peace. I will trust You with tomorrow.

title: When God Feels Silent About Your Future
hook: If God feels silent about your future, listen to this.
script: If God feels silent about your future, listen to this. Jesus pointed to birds and lilies for a reason: creation is a sermon about care. If the small things are fed and clothed, how much more you? When you cannot hear next year, follow today's voice: seek first the Kingdom. Choose the loving next step, not the loudest fear. Practice the 24-hour rule: do the next right thing for the next 24 hours, and let tomorrow be God's inbox. Prayer: Father, I give You my future. Lead my step today, guard my heart today, and meet me again tomorrow.

title: The 24-Hour Rule of Grace (Matthew 6:34)
hook: This truth can change how you see your struggle.
script: This truth can change how you see your struggle: grace is delivered daily. Jesus said tomorrow will worry about itself, so meet your fear with a simple rhythm. Name the worry. Ask, is this a problem I can act on today? If yes, take one small step in love and leave the rest. If no, park it for a 10-minute slot tonight and return to now. That is how we seek first the Kingdom in real time. Gratitude for today's bread. Obedience for today's hour. Prayer: Father, I choose today. Provide, guide, and calm me today. Tomorrow, I will trust You again.
